package.name: gear_insertion_ros2_cpp
package.description: C++ (rclcpp + LibTorch) equivalent of the gear_insertion_ros2 Python package: a TorchScript policy inference node and a success-rate monitor, for AI-model validation against the Isaac-Sim-simulated "robot" (GearInsertionPolicy/scripts/ros2_isaac_sim_bridge.py). Same ROS2 topic contract as the Python nodes -- see the project README.md.
